summary: An explicit exact-rank-three Parseval Fourier frame with nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}, a heavy null row, macroscopic total bilinear export and max physical pair area tending to zero admits no spectral 1+2 decomposition whose scalar direction and transverse plane have disjoint original-coordinate supports. Every nonzero spectral vector has outside coordinates A+B cos(theta_j)+C sin(theta_j), hence at most two outside zeros. This refutes automatic exact bank separation only, not the QFORM conjecture. For even m, antipodal pairing localizes the overlap into independent 2D blocks with joint density <=1/2, suggesting a block-level parabolic/Brascamp-Lieb replacement.
